title: Born in New Orleans; mother's violin and early lessons
summary: Born 1908; his mother studied classical violin and gave him hers around age ten, and he took lessons then dropped it.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: And your birthday, do you mind my answer?
November the 8th, 9th. Born 1908. November the 9th, 1908. The 60th or 70th of November.
We'll have to wish you a happy birthday, but early. Did you come from a musical family or anything?
My mother studied violin. She was, um... But she never did violin.
Do you know who she studied violin number?
Was she a jazz violin player or classical? No, classical.
Classical, right. Do you remember what she played? Any pieces? No.

The reason why I don't know, because when I was born, she had gave that up. Oh, I see. Because she gave me that violin when I got around about 10 years old. She gave it to me. Did you play anything? I took lessons from Willie, uncle's grandfather. I was going to school and taking lessons from him. Then I didn't like instruments, so I gave it up, too.
